items.comment: you cannot make that statement without providing any statistical evidence (as a result of stat testing, some p-value)
These tables are illegible, the font is far too small.

This discussion of the results reflects their analysis and interpretation. It should be integrated with the Results. You present the results, explain them, analyse and interpret. Here you present all the results and then you discuss all the results. These aspects should be inherently intertwined - finding after finding. Also, the analysis has to be supported by statistical testing to provide statistically meaningful evidence. Otherwise everything is inconclusive, reflecting trends rather than concrete conclusive outcomes.
